name: agentic-funnel
description: Open-source Stripe funnel infrastructure for low-ticket digital products.

scripts.check:worker: sh -ac 'set -a; . ./.env; set +a; pnpm --filter @agentic-funnel/worker exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json'
scripts.db:check: sh -ac 'set -a; . ./.env; set +a; pnpm --filter @agentic-funnel/db exec drizzle-kit check'
scripts.db:generate: sh -ac 'set -a; . ./.env; set +a; pnpm --filter @agentic-funnel/db exec drizzle-kit generate'
scripts.db:push: sh -ac 'set -a; . ./.env; set +a; pnpm --filter @agentic-funnel/db exec drizzle-kit push'
scripts.local:logs: docker compose logs -f postgres minio minio-setup
